# 💡 the pairwise peer reference
**concept** · shared · knowledge

The cred-spec's R-DID rule (a fresh, unique reference per counterparty) enforced at the overlay: two viewers' projections of one pin share NO identifier field, so two people who both met the same walker cannot join their views. The shipped game returned a raw avatar guid + global display name on every peer pin; the fix — a face chosen per edge at meet time — costs one text field.
> *A face per edge, chosen at the meet.*
